The strike is straightforward and without excess. It is sufficiently swift, such that the Seaborn cannot avoid it despite its wishes.
content: The strike is straightforward and without excess. It is sufficiently swift, such that the Seaborn cannot avoid it despite its wishes.

raw: Afterwards, an enormous rumbling sound proves that the strike was also sufficiently strong.
content: Afterwards, an enormous rumbling sound proves that the strike was also sufficiently strong.

content: By the time the Seaborn is miserably thrown against a turret that's never been fired, its body had already been considerably cut down in size.

raw: [name="Ulpianus"]Like so. Grasp its movements. Make a decision. Swing your weapon. Aim to kill.
speaker: Ulpianus
content: Like so. Grasp its movements. Make a decision. Swing your weapon. Aim to kill.

raw: [name="Ulpianus"]This is how you fight them. You are slower than before, and more cautious. Your life on land has been no small influence on you.
speaker: Ulpianus
content: This is how you fight them. You are slower than before, and more cautious. Your life on land has been no small influence on you.

raw: [name="Skadi"]I... I never thought... but how did you survive?
speaker: Skadi
content: I... I never thought... but how did you survive?

raw: [name="Skadi"]I thought you died... But you, and Swordfish, how did you two survive?
speaker: Skadi
content: I thought you died... But you, and Swordfish, how did you two survive?

raw: [name="Skadi"]What about the others then? The 1st Company, and the 4th Company? Did they—
speaker: Skadi
content: What about the others then? The 1st Company, and the 4th Company? Did they—

raw: [name="Ulpianus"]By my standards, my survival was a tragedy. The Seaborn told me that the others could not be allowed to live on. They would not have overlooked anything in their nest.
speaker: Ulpianus
content: By my standards, my survival was a tragedy. The Seaborn told me that the others could not be allowed to live on. They would not have overlooked anything in their nest.

raw: [name="Ulpianus"]Of course, based on Gladiia's usual attitude, by her standards this was also a disgrace.
speaker: Ulpianus
content: Of course, based on Gladiia's usual attitude, by her standards this was also a disgrace.

raw: [name="Gladiia"]Finish it off first. As for your situation, we can wait for all the Hunters to arrive.
speaker: Gladiia
content: Finish it off first. As for your situation, we can wait for all the Hunters to arrive.

raw: [name="Seaborn"]You, in this dry, floating vessel... on this ship, hunt. You, left our kind.
speaker: Seaborn
content: You, in this dry, floating vessel... on this ship, hunt. You, left our kind.

raw: [name="Seaborn"]Death, does not benefit our kind. Your death, also does not benefit our kind.
speaker: Seaborn
content: Death, does not benefit our kind. Your death, also does not benefit our kind.

speaker: Seaborn
content: You—

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=8, ystrength=6, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Seaborn
content: Urk—!

raw: [name="Captain Alfonso"]Pah. What kind of hunter talks before his quarry is dead? That's the first lesson we teach in field training.
speaker: Captain Alfonso
content: Pah. What kind of hunter talks before his quarry is dead? That's the first lesson we teach in field training.

raw: [name="Captain Alfonso"]I seem to always be cleaning up after the messes of you Ægirs.
speaker: Captain Alfonso
content: I seem to always be cleaning up after the messes of you Ægirs.

raw: [name="Captain Alfonso"]What is it you want? What do you need with my ship? Look what you did to Iberia, and to Victoria. Letting monsters overrun Ursus...
speaker: Captain Alfonso
content: What is it you want? What do you need with my ship? Look what you did to Iberia, and to Victoria. Letting monsters overrun Ursus...

speaker: Seaborn
content: (Roars) —!

speaker: Captain Alfonso
content: Urgh, stubborn bastard!

raw: [Blocker(a=1, r=1, g=1, b=1, afrom=0, rfrom=0, gfrom=0, bfrom=0, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=true)]

speaker: Seaborn
content: (Screeches) ——!

speaker: Inquisitor Irene
content: Run it through! Now, Alfonso!

speaker: Captain Alfonso
content: Take this!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=8, ystrength=6, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Captain Alfonso
content: Haah...

speaker: Inquisitor Irene
content: I-Is it over?

raw: [name="Inquisitor Irene"]Ugh... I can't... feel my hand...
speaker: Inquisitor Irene
content: Ugh... I can't... feel my hand...

speaker: Gladiia
content: ...Look out beneath you!

speaker: Captain Alfonso
content: What?

speaker: Gladiia
content: It's not dead yet!

speaker: Seaborn
content: ... (Blood gurgles in its throat) Grrrgh...

speaker: Seaborn
content: Urgh...

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Captain Alfonso"]It chipped through the deck. Trying to jump onto the chopping block yourself, you sack of meat?
speaker: Captain Alfonso
content: It chipped through the deck. Trying to jump onto the chopping block yourself, you sack of meat?

speaker: Ulpianus
content: ...No, not quite.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Ulpianus"]After it! We didn't chase it back into the cabin, there are still more of its kin on the ship!
speaker: Ulpianus
content: After it! We didn't chase it back into the cabin, there are still more of its kin on the ship!

speaker: Ulpianus
content: It's looking for her!

speaker: Seaborn
content: ...Urgh... *gurgle*...

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Seaborn
content: (Chewing sounds) ...Urgh... Kraaahh...

speaker: Amaia
content: Herald.

speaker: Seaborn
content: ...Scaleless, kin.

raw: [name="Seaborn"]Wounds, can't be healed. No way, to nourish our kind.
speaker: Seaborn
content: Wounds, can't be healed. No way, to nourish our kind.

raw: [name="Seaborn"]They all, attack. Attack, but not to hunt.
speaker: Seaborn
content: They all, attack. Attack, but not to hunt.
Amaia simply listens quietly.

raw: The wound Specter left on her slender body continues to bleed, dripping into the pool of blood already shed by the Seaborn and mixing into one.
content: The wound Specter left on her slender body continues to bleed, dripping into the pool of blood already shed by the Seaborn and mixing into one.
Amaia simply listens quietly.

speaker: Seaborn
content: ...You, also hurt.

speaker: Seaborn
content: You, consume me.

speaker: Seaborn
content: Kin, you live.

speaker: Seaborn
content: Our kind, will continue, and survive.

raw: The Seaborn bows its body, lowering itself at Amaia's feet.
content: The Seaborn bows its body, lowering itself at Amaia's feet.

raw: It closes its eyes and awaits death.
content: It closes its eyes and awaits death.
Amaia continues to listen quietly.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Dedication, sacrifice.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="These sorts of unrequited altruism are respected by humans, and considered virtues.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: These sorts of unrequited altruism are respected by humans, and considered virtues.

raw: [name="Amaia"]Ægir. I have never seen that country myself. A vast, vast country, larger than Iberia, Victoria, or Ursus. Or perhaps all three combined.
speaker: Amaia
content: Ægir. I have never seen that country myself. A vast, vast country, larger than Iberia, Victoria, or Ursus. Or perhaps all three combined.

raw: [name="Amaia"]I've heard that the Ægir are rationalists. But how rational can they be, compared to the rationality of our kin?
speaker: Amaia
content: I've heard that the Ægir are rationalists. But how rational can they be, compared to the rationality of our kin?

speaker: Amaia
content: Listen to me, Herald.

raw: [name="Amaia"]There is nothing noble about sacrifice, and dedication is not necessarily a virtue.
speaker: Amaia
content: There is nothing noble about sacrifice, and dedication is not necessarily a virtue.

speaker: Seaborn
content: Virtue...? Noble...?

raw: [name="Amaia"]You do not need to understand what sacrifice or dedication are. Only the mediocre would presume that the Seaborn becoming closer to humanity is any form of evolution.
speaker: Amaia
content: You do not need to understand what sacrifice or dedication are. Only the mediocre would presume that the Seaborn becoming closer to humanity is any form of evolution.

speaker: Amaia
content: No.

raw: [name="Amaia"]This is merely an increased tolerance to allow for more possibilities.
speaker: Amaia
content: This is merely an increased tolerance to allow for more possibilities.

raw: [name="Amaia"]When we praise those who selflessly serve their kin, all that means is that so many more have chosen to do otherwise.
speaker: Amaia
content: When we praise those who selflessly serve their kin, all that means is that so many more have chosen to do otherwise.

raw: [name="Amaia"]If even young gloompincers will die in the jaws of their natural predators to protect their kind, then why do we feel a need to repeatedly extol such a virtue?
speaker: Amaia
content: If even young gloompincers will die in the jaws of their natural predators to protect their kind, then why do we feel a need to repeatedly extol such a virtue?

raw: [name="Amaia"]Humans only sing the praises of what's rare, using morality to whitewash altruism. All in an attempt to justify their utilitarian hearts, deeming themselves more noble than beasts.
speaker: Amaia
content: Humans only sing the praises of what's rare, using morality to whitewash altruism. All in an attempt to justify their utilitarian hearts, deeming themselves more noble than beasts.

raw: [name="Amaia"]Such ridiculous self-aggrandizement. It is clear that the cracks between nations and races are tearing this land asunder.
speaker: Amaia
content: Such ridiculous self-aggrandizement. It is clear that the cracks between nations and races are tearing this land asunder.

raw: [name="Amaia"]'Life has never been without order,' my Herald. This is the final answer I sought, for which I left the land and entered the sea.
speaker: Amaia
content: 'Life has never been without order,' my Herald. This is the final answer I sought, for which I left the land and entered the sea.

raw: The Seaborn closes its eyes. It is contemplating the words of Amaia, the words of its kin.
content: The Seaborn closes its eyes. It is contemplating the words of Amaia, the words of its kin.

raw: It does not understand, but its kin says that it does not need to understand, only to do.
content: It does not understand, but its kin says that it does not need to understand, only to do.

raw: The next moment, it feels its scaleless kin place her hand upon its body.
content: The next moment, it feels its scaleless kin place her hand upon its body.
Its kin says:
'I ask of you.'
'Remember me.'
'Set me free.'
'Consume me.'

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Ulpianus
content: Amaia!

raw: [name="Ulpianus"]No... The scent is still here. It couldn't have gotten far.
speaker: Ulpianus
content: No... The scent is still here. It couldn't have gotten far.

raw: [name="Gladiia"]It cut through the walls corroded by the nethersea brand and returned to the ocean.
speaker: Gladiia
content: It cut through the walls corroded by the nethersea brand and returned to the ocean.

raw: [name="Ulpianus"]But that's not all. Something happened here. Its blood trails disappeared.
speaker: Ulpianus
content: But that's not all. Something happened here. Its blood trails disappeared.

raw: [name="Ulpianus"]...You all stay here. I'll go after it myself.
speaker: Ulpianus
content: ...You all stay here. I'll go after it myself.

raw: [name="Gladiia"]Why would Hunters be afraid to return to the ocean? This is a disgrace.
speaker: Gladiia
content: Why would Hunters be afraid to return to the ocean? This is a disgrace.

raw: [name="Ulpianus"]Then stew in that disgrace, Gladiia. We need to tread carefully, and I alone will be enough to handle this.
speaker: Ulpianus
content: Then stew in that disgrace, Gladiia. We need to tread carefully, and I alone will be enough to handle this.

speaker: Gladiia
content: I'll go with you.

speaker: Ulpianus
content: To monitor me?

speaker: Gladiia
content: To maintain discipline.

raw: [name="Ulpianus"]As you please. But surely you can feel it too.
speaker: Ulpianus
content: As you please. But surely you can feel it too.

raw: [name="Ulpianus"]More Seaborn are approaching. This place may be closer to shore, but it's already become the heart of the ocean.
speaker: Ulpianus
content: More Seaborn are approaching. This place may be closer to shore, but it's already become the heart of the ocean.

speaker: Rocinante
content: *brays*...

raw: [name="The Last Knight"]...Soon, soon— the grand domain.
speaker: The Last Knight
content: ...Soon, soon— the grand domain.

speaker: The Last Knight
content: Very soon.

raw: [name="The Last Knight"]The storm is tearing the sky open. The terrible waves, they come, they will come.
speaker: The Last Knight
content: The storm is tearing the sky open. The terrible waves, they come, they will come.

raw: [name="The Last Knight"]We shall watch. We shall wait.
speaker: The Last Knight
content: We shall watch. We shall wait.

raw: [name="The Last Knight"]We shall meet the terrible waves.
speaker: The Last Knight
content: We shall meet the terrible waves.
